# GoEasyTools — Full Technical & Algorithmic Manifest

This document provides complete mathematical formulas, parsing specifications, counting rules, platform boundary constraints, and privacy contracts for all utilities on https://goeasytools.com.

---

## Architecture & Privacy Guarantee
1. **Client-Side Processing:** All computations execute inside the user's browser runtime using standard Web APIs (WebAssembly, HTML5 2D Canvas Context, Web Crypto API `crypto.getRandomValues`).
2. **Zero Uploads:** Typed strings, uploaded images, and PDF binary streams are never transmitted over network sockets or saved in server logs.
3. **Canonical Base URL:** https://goeasytools.com

---

## 1. Text Utilities

### Word Counter
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/word-counter
- **Counting Heuristics:**
  - Words: Split on whitespace sequence `\s+`. Non-spaced scripts (e.g. Japanese without spaces) count as a single token.
  - Characters (with spaces): Full count of Unicode code points.
  - Characters (without spaces): Unicode code points filtering out whitespace characters (`\s`).
  - Sentences: Regex sentence termination boundary using `[.!?]+`, exempting decimals (e.g., `3.14`) and standard abbreviations (`Dr.`, `Mr.`, `Mrs.`, `Ms.`, `Prof.`, `Sr.`, `Jr.`, `e.g.`, `i.e.`, `vs.`, `etc.`, `approx.`, `est.`, `min.`, `max.`, `dept.`, `univ.`, `vol.`, `no.`).
  - Paragraphs: Blocks separated by one or more blank lines (`\n\s*\n`).
  - Reading Time: Calculated using standard baseline of 200 words per minute (`ceil(words / 200)` minutes).

### Character Counter
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/character-counter
- **Counting Rules:**
  - Unicode code point evaluation.
  - Optional limit subtraction: `Remaining = Limit - Total Characters`.
  - Common thresholds: Twitter/X (280), SMS (160), Meta Title (60), Meta Description (160).

### Case Converter
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/case-converter
- **Supported Conversions:**
  - UPPERCASE: Full uppercase string mapping (`toLocaleUpperCase('en')`).
  - lowercase: Full lowercase string mapping (`toLocaleLowerCase('en')`).
  - Title Case: Capitalizes first character of each word, lowercases remaining characters.
  - Sentence case: Capitalizes first character of the string and first letter following sentence terminators (`.`, `!`, `?`).
  - camelCase: Lowercases first word, capitalizes subsequent words, strips delimiters.
  - PascalCase: Capitalizes every word, strips delimiters.
  - snake_case: Delimits lowercase words with underscores (`_`).
  - kebab-case: Delimits lowercase words with hyphens (`-`).

---

## 2. Calculators & Financial

### Percentage Calculator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/percentage-calculator
- **Formulas:**
  - Percent of a number: `(Percent × Value) / 100`
  - What percent is X of Y: `(X / Y) × 100`
  - Percentage change (Increase/Decrease): `((New - Original) / Original) × 100`
  - Percentage difference (Directionless): `(|A - B| / ((|A| + |B|) / 2)) × 100`
  - Original before increase: `Final / (1 + Rate / 100)`
  - Original before discount: `Final / (1 - Rate / 100)`
- **Boundaries:** Division by zero yields an undefined error result; decimal numbers use period (`.`) format.

### Discount Calculator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/discount-calculator
- **Formulas:**
  - Single Discount: `Savings = Price × (Rate / 100)`, `Final Price = Price - Savings`
  - Sequential Second Discount: `Price_Intermediate = Price - Savings_1`, `Savings_2 = Price_Intermediate × (Rate_2 / 100)`, `Final Price = Price_Intermediate - Savings_2`
  - Supported Currencies: USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), INR (₹), BRL (R$), SAR (SR).

### EMI Calculator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/emi-calculator
- **Formula:** Reducing-balance loan amortization:
  `EMI = [P × r × (1 + r)^n] / [(1 + r)^n - 1]`
  Where `P` = Principal, `r` = Monthly interest rate (`Annual Rate / (12 × 100)`), `n` = Tenure in months.
- **Boundaries:** Zero interest rate calculates `P / n`; maximum allowed tenure is 360 months (30 years).

### GST Calculator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/gst-calculator
- **Formulas:**
  - Add GST (Tax Exclusive): `Tax = Amount × (Rate / 100)`, `Gross = Amount + Tax`
  - Remove GST (Tax Inclusive): `Net Taxable = Amount / (1 + Rate / 100)`, `Tax = Amount - Net Taxable`
  - Tax Split: Central GST (CGST) = 50% of Tax, State GST (SGST) = 50% of Tax; odd hundredths round to CGST. Inter-state IGST = 100% of Tax.

### Unit Converter
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/unit-converter
- **Conversion Constants (SI & Imperial):**
  - Length: 1 in = 0.0254 m (exact), 1 ft = 0.3048 m (exact), 1 mi = 1,609.344 m (exact).
  - Mass: 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg (exact), 1 oz = 0.028349523125 kg (exact).
  - Temperature: `F = (C × 9/5) + 32`, `C = (F - 32) × 5/9`, `K = C + 273.15`.
  - Volume: 1 US gallon = 3.785411784 L (exact).

### Date Calculator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/date-calculator
- **Conventions:**
  - Calendar Days: Difference in elapsed midnights between ISO 8601 calendar dates.
  - Business Days: Counts Monday through Friday dates within the specified interval, excluding weekends.

### Age Calculator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/age-calculator
- **Conventions:** Chronological age computed across full calendar years, remaining full months, and remaining days. Leap day (February 29) birthdays recognize anniversary on February 28 in non-leap years.

## 3. Developer Utilities

### JSON Formatter & Validator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/json-formatter
- **Specifications:**
  - Parsing: Native `JSON.parse()`. Provides exact line and column error position diagnostics.
  - Formatting: `JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)` for pretty-printing; whitespace-stripped compact output for minification.
  - Limits: 1,000,000 character maximum to prevent browser tab locking.

### Base64 Encoder & Decoder
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/base64
- **Specifications:**
  - Standards: RFC 4648 Base64 character alphabet (`A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, `+`, `/`, padding `=`).
  - Encoding: Uses UTF-8 bytes (`TextEncoder` / `TextDecoder`) to handle multi-byte characters and emojis without data loss.

### Password Generator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/password-generator
- **Specifications:**
  - Randomness: Web Crypto API `crypto.getRandomValues()` with rejection sampling to eliminate modulo bias.
  - Exclusions: Excludes ambiguous glyphs (`1`, `l`, `I`, `0`, `O`).
  - Length: 8 to 64 characters.

### QR Code Generator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/qr-code-generator
- **Specifications:**
  - Formats: Website URLs (`http://`, `https://`), plain text, and Wi-Fi networks (`WIFI:T:WPA;S:SSID;P:PASSWORD;;`).
  - Output: High-contrast 2D matrix exported as client-side PNG canvas download.

### JWT Decoder
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/jwt-decoder
- **Specifications:**
  - Parsing: Base64URL decodes header and payload with standard `TextDecoder`. Slices token into 3 dot-separated segments.
  - Claims: Evaluates standard RFC 7519 claims: `exp` (expiration), `iat` (issued at), `nbf` (not before), `iss`, `sub`, and `aud`.
  - Security: 100% in-browser parsing. Bearer credentials are never transmitted over network sockets or logged.

### URL Encoder & Decoder
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/url-encoder
- **Specifications:**
  - Standard: RFC 3986 percent-encoding specification.
  - Modes: URL Component (`encodeURIComponent`), Full URL (`encodeURI`), and Query Parameter Table parser.
  - Multi-byte: Full UTF-8 multi-byte encoding/decoding. Optional space-as-plus (`+`) encoding.

### JSON to TypeScript
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/json-to-typescript
- **Specifications:**
  - AST Inference: Recursively traverses JSON objects and arrays to infer property data types (`string`, `number`, `boolean`, `any`, arrays, and unions).
  - Structure: Separates nested objects into modular child interfaces or type aliases with configurable root identifier name.
  - Formatting: Wraps reserved symbols and hyphenated keys in quotes for syntactically valid TypeScript code. Client-side execution.

### JSON to Python
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/json-to-python
- **Specifications:**
  - Target Frameworks: Pydantic BaseModel (v2) with Field aliases, standard library `@dataclass`, and `typing.TypedDict`.
  - Type Mapping: Maps JSON types to Python types (`str`, `int`, `float`, `bool`, `Optional[Any]`, `List[T]`).
  - PEP 8: Automatic conversion of camelCase JSON keys into snake_case with Pydantic Field alias preservation. Runs entirely client-side.

### CSV to JSON Converter
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/csv-to-json
- **Specifications:**
  - Standard: RFC 4180 parsing with full support for quoted values, escaped quotes (`""`), and embedded newlines.
  - Delimiters: Auto-detection and explicit support for comma (`,`), tab (`\t`), semicolon (`;`), and pipe (`|`).
  - Conversion: Bidirectional CSV to JSON array of objects and JSON to CSV spreadsheet export. Optional numeric and boolean type coercion.

### Contrast Checker
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/contrast-checker
- **Specifications:**
  - Standard: W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 relative luminance and contrast algorithm.
  - Evaluation: Calculates contrast ratio between 1:1 and 21:1. Assesses Level AA (4.5:1 normal / 3.0:1 large text) and Level AAA (7.0:1 normal / 4.5:1 large text).
  - Preview: Renders live text and component previews directly in client-side canvas and DOM. Zero server tracking.

### CSS Gradient Generator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/gradient-generator
- **Specifications:**
  - Types: Linear gradients with 0° to 360° angle dials and radial gradients with circular or elliptical focus shapes.
  - Controls: Multi-stop color placement (0% to 100%) with up to 6 custom stops and curated aesthetic presets.
  - Code Export: Emits standard fallback declarations, cross-browser CSS rules, and Tailwind arbitrary values. Local canvas rendering.

### Color Palette Generator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/color-palette-generator
- **Specifications:**
  - Harmony Modes: Analogous, Monochromatic, Triadic, Complementary, and Split-Complementary schemes derived via HSL color wheel angles.
  - Features: Real-time Spacebar randomizer, individual swatch pin-locking, and instant CSS root variables (:root) export. 100% in-browser computation.

### CSS Box Shadow Generator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/css-box-shadow-generator
- **Specifications:**
  - Syntax: Compiles standard CSS and webkit box-shadow rules with X-offset, Y-offset, blur radius, spread radius, color, and inset properties.
  - Multi-layer: Composites up to 4 custom shadow layers for natural photorealistic ambient occlusion. Instant live preview and Tailwind class export.

### CSS Border Radius Generator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/css-border-radius-generator
- **Specifications:**
  - Modes: Simple 4-corner pixel radii and advanced 8-point percentage slash syntax (`H / V`).
  - Output: Organic liquid blobs, asymmetric cards, and pills with live shape preview and copyable pure CSS and Tailwind utility classes. Zero server uploads.

### Regex Tester
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/regex-tester
- **Specifications:**
  - Engine: Native ECMAScript (JavaScript) RegExp engine.
  - Features: Supports standard flags (g, i, m, s, u), named and indexed capture groups, real-time match highlighting, and execution timing benchmarks.
  - Safety: Capped global iterations and zero-length loop guards protect against catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS). Client-side execution.

### Cron Expression Generator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/cron-generator
- **Specifications:**
  - Syntax: Standard 5-field Unix cron expression (minute, hour, day-of-month, month, day-of-week).
  - Translation: Instant bidirectional visual builder and human-readable natural English schedule interpreter.
  - Projection: Projects the next 5 upcoming execution timestamps relative to the user's local timezone. Zero server logging.

### SQL Formatter
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/sql-formatter
- **Specifications:**
  - Formatting: Organizes major clauses (SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT) and sub-clauses (JOINs, ON, AND, OR) onto clean lines with configurable 2 or 4-space indentation.
  - Standardizing: Capitalizes SQL reserved keywords and preserves comments and string literals intact.
  - Minification: Strips comments and excessive whitespace for single-line production deployment. Zero server logging.

### Barcode Generator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/barcode-generator
- **Specifications:**
  - Formats: Code 128 (all 128 ASCII chars with modulo-103 check), EAN-13 (13-digit retail GTIN with modulo-10 check), UPC-A (12-digit North American retail), and Code 39.
  - Export: Renders crisp vector SVG XML and client-side 2x canvas-rasterized PNG downloads with automated optical quiet zones. 100% private in-browser generation.

---

## 4. Image & PDF Utilities

### Image Compressor
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/image-compressor
- **Specifications:**
  - Processing: HTML5 2D Canvas `toBlob` re-encoding.
  - Formats: JPG, PNG (lossless optimization), WebP. Maximum file size: 15 MB.

### Image Resizer
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/image-resizer
- **Specifications:**
  - Processing: Pixel scaling on HTML5 Canvas.
  - Dimensions: Pixel width and height adjustments with optional aspect-ratio lock.

### Image Cropper
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/image-cropper
- **Specifications:**
  - Canvas Extraction: Extracts pixel coordinate bounding boxes at 100% native resolution via HTML5 2D canvas context.
  - Presets: Freeform, 1:1 Square, 16:9 Widescreen, 4:3 Standard, and 3:2 Photo ratios with visual rule-of-thirds grid overlay.
  - Formats: JPG, PNG, and WebP up to 15 MB. Zero server uploads.

### Merge PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/merge-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Processing: In-browser binary page manipulation via `pdf-lib`.
  - Bounds: 2 to 10 PDF documents, maximum 20 MB per file. Encrypted documents refused.

### Split PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/split-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Extraction: Range parsing supporting individual pages and contiguous ranges (e.g. `1-3, 5`).
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### JPG to PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/jpg-to-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Embedding: JPG and PNG images embedded directly into PDF canvas streams.
  - Page Sizing: International A4 (595.28 × 841.89 points) with proportional fit margins or native image dimensions.

### Rotate PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/rotate-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Rotation: Clockwise by 90°, 180°, or 270°. Additive to any existing page rotation.
  - Scope: All pages rotated uniformly. Encrypted files refused.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### Organize PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/organize-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Reordering: Arbitrary page order via comma-separated page numbers and ranges (e.g. `3,1,2` or `1-3,5`).
  - Duplication: Same page number may appear multiple times to duplicate pages.
  - Deletion: Omitting a page number removes that page from the output.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### Crop PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/crop-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Cropping: Sets the CropBox on each page using top, right, bottom, and left margins in PDF points (72 pt = 1 inch).
  - Content Preservation: Content outside the crop area is hidden, not deleted. The original MediaBox is unchanged.
  - Validation: Refuses margins that leave zero or negative visible area.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### Add Page Numbers
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/add-page-numbers
- **Specifications:**
  - Positions: bottom-center (default), bottom-left, bottom-right, top-center, top-left, top-right.
  - Numbers start from a configurable integer (default 1) and increment sequentially.
  - Font: Helvetica, configurable size (default 12pt).
  - Margin: 36pt (0.5 inch) from page edges.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### Watermark PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/watermark-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Text watermark centered on each page in semi-transparent grey (rgb 0.5, 0.5, 0.5).
  - Configurable font size (default 48pt), opacity (0.01–1.0, default 0.3), and diagonal (45°) toggle.
  - Font: Helvetica embedded.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### Unlock PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/unlock-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Loads the PDF with encryption bypassed and re-saves all pages into a new unrestricted document.
  - Works for PDFs with owner-only or empty passwords. Strongly encrypted files that block page extraction will fail.
  - Optional password field (processed client-side, never transmitted).
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### PDF to JPG
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/pdf-to-jpg
- **Specifications:**
  - Renders each PDF page to a canvas using pdfjs-dist and exports as JPEG.
  - Default JPEG quality: 0.85, adjustable from 0.1 to 1.0.
  - Default scale: 2× (144 dpi), adjustable from 0.5× to 4×.
  - Single-page PDFs download as a .jpg file; multi-page PDFs download as a .zip archive.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### Compress PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/compress-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Copies all pages into a fresh PDFDocument and saves with object-stream compression.
  - Lossless: no images are downsampled and no text is removed.
  - Reports original size, compressed size, and percentage reduction.
  - Typical savings: 5–20% on unoptimized PDFs. Already-optimized files may see no reduction.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### Edit PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/edit-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Draws text on PDF pages using pdf-lib `page.drawText()` with Helvetica font.
  - Each annotation specifies: page number (1-based), X/Y coordinates (PDF points from bottom-left), font size, and RGB colour.
  - Multiple annotations per document. Out-of-range page indices are skipped.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### PDF Forms
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/pdf-forms
- **Specifications:**
  - Reads AcroForm fields from PDF: text fields, checkboxes, dropdowns, radio groups.
  - Signature and button fields are detected but not fillable.
  - XFA forms are not supported.
  - Optional flatten converts interactive fields to static page content.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### Sign PDF
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/sign-pdf
- **Specifications:**
  - Signature creation: Draw freehand on canvas, type name in cursive script, or upload PNG/JPG image.
  - Placement: Page number (1-based), X/Y coordinates (PDF points from bottom-left), width, and height.
  - Embedding: Signature rendered as PNG and embedded via pdf-lib `page.drawImage()`.
  - Visual only: Does not apply cryptographic digital signatures (PKI).
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### Delete PDF Pages
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/delete-pdf-pages
- **Specifications:**
  - Input: Page numbers or ranges to delete (e.g. 2, 4-6). Uses the same range parser as Split PDF.
  - Logic: Keeps all pages NOT in the delete set and copies them into a new document.
  - Validation: Refuses if deletion would leave zero pages.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### Extract PDF Pages
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/extract-pdf-pages
- **Specifications:**
  - Input: Page numbers or ranges to extract (e.g. 1-3, 5). Same range parser as Split PDF.
  - Logic: Copies only specified pages into a new document in the given order.
  - Validation: Page numbers must be within the document range.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB.

### PDF Pipeline
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/pdf-pipeline
- **Specifications:**
  - Workflow: Upload once, chain unlimited operations without re-uploading.
  - Operations: Rotate, delete pages, extract pages, organize, crop, add page numbers, watermark, compress, unlock.
  - Version History: Every operation creates a versioned copy (v0, v1, v2...). Click any version to jump to it.
  - Undo/Redo: Go back or forward through the version timeline. Applying from an earlier version branches (replaces later versions).
  - Size Tracking: Shows page count and file size at each version, plus percentage change from original.
  - Privacy: All versions stored in browser memory. Nothing uploaded. History lost on tab close.
  - Bounds: 1 PDF document up to 20 MB per input.

### UK VAT Calculator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/vat-calculator-uk
- **Specifications:**
  - Standard HMRC Rates: Standard (20%), Reduced (5%), Zero (0%), and custom rates.
  - Calculations: Add VAT (Gross = Net × (1 + Rate)) and Reverse VAT (Net = Gross / (1 + Rate)).
  - Currency: British Pounds (GBP £) with two-decimal precision.

### Australia GST Calculator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/gst-calculator-australia
- **Specifications:**
  - Standard ATO Rates: 10% Goods and Services Tax.
  - Statutory 1/11th Rule: Inclusive GST = Total / 11; Net = Total − (Total / 11).
  - Currency: Australian Dollars (AUD $) with two-decimal precision.

### France TVA Calculator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/france-tva-calculator
- **Specifications:**
  - Rates: Normal 20%, Intermediate 10%, Reduced 5.5%, Super-reduced 2.1%, and custom.
  - Directions: TVA-exclusive (add TVA) and TVA-inclusive (reverse-calculate net amount).
  - Currency: Euro (€) with two-decimal precision.

### Belgium TVA Calculator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/belgium-tva-calculator
- **Specifications:**
  - Rates: Standard 21%, Reduced 6%, Intermediate 12%, and custom.
  - Directions: TVA-exclusive (add TVA) and TVA-inclusive (reverse-calculate net amount).
  - Currency: Euro (€) with two-decimal precision.

### Slug Generator
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/slug-generator
- **Specifications:**
  - Unicode Normalization: Form KD (NFKD) decomposes combined glyphs, transliterating accented Latin (e.g. é → e, ñ → n).
  - Multilingual Script Support: Preserves non-Latin Unicode scripts (Arabic, Cyrillic, Devanagari) while stripping punctuation.
  - Delimiters: Configurable hyphens (-) or underscores (_).

### Remove Duplicate Lines
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/remove-duplicate-lines
- **Specifications:**
  - Operations: Remove duplicate lines, trim whitespace, remove blank lines, sort alphabetically.
  - Case Sensitivity: Configurable case-sensitive or case-insensitive deduplication.
  - Privacy: 100% client-side with zero server uploads.

### Color Converter
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/color-converter
- **Specifications:**
  - Formats: HEX (3/6/8-digit), RGB (0–255), HSL (hue 0–360, saturation/lightness 0–100%).
  - Live Preview: Real-time color swatch updates as values change.
  - Copy: One-click CSS color string copy for each format.

### Unix Timestamp Converter
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/unix-timestamp-converter
- **Specifications:**
  - Conversions: Unix seconds ↔ UTC date-time, Unix milliseconds ↔ UTC date-time, local timezone display.
  - Current Timestamp: Shows live current Unix timestamp in seconds and milliseconds.
  - Privacy: 100% client-side with zero server requests.

### Text Diff Checker
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/text-compare
- **Specifications:**
  - Algorithm: In-browser Longest Common Subsequence (Myers diff) algorithm.
  - Modes: Line-by-line diff and word-by-word diff.
  - Privacy: 100% client-side computation with zero server transit. Bounded to 100,000 characters per panel.

---

## 5. Audio & Media Utilities

### Audio Trimmer
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/audio-trimmer
- **Specifications:**
  - Decoding: Native Web Audio API (`AudioContext.decodeAudioData`) supporting MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, and M4A up to 50 MB.
  - Waveform: Canvas amplitude peak scrubbing with synchronized audio playback preview.
  - Encoding: Pure client-side 16-bit PCM RIFF WAV serialization. Zero server uploads.

### Audio Speed Changer
- **URL:** https://goeasytools.com/audio-speed-changer
- **Specifications:**
  - Tempo Modification: Variable playback rates from 0.25x to 3.0x with real-time interactive preview.
  - Rendering: Hardware-accelerated `OfflineAudioContext` multi-threaded buffer rendering.
  - Export: Lossless 16-bit PCM RIFF WAV audio container. 100% in-browser processing.
